name: Sonoma Smart Vineyard
challenge: California's unpredictable drought cycles were forcing the vineyard to over-irrigate as a precaution, wasting up to 40% of applied water. Without granular soil data, vintners were making irrigation decisions blindly, resulting in inconsistent grape quality across the 6 micro-terroir zones and year-on-year yield variance of ±28%.
solution: HariLeaf installed Soil-DNA Analytics sensors across all 6 zones, feeding real-time chemical composition data into HydroLogic Hub's predictive models. LeafSense AI Vision cameras mounted on end-of-row posts monitor canopy health, UV exposure, and early disease signatures. Data is unified in a single dashboard updated every 15 minutes.
farmerQuote: We went from guessing at irrigation to knowing exactly what each row of vines needs, hour by hour. Our water bill is down 72% and the grapes have never been more consistent.
